about_pullquote: I started this business because I was fed up seeing customers overcharged for simple fixes.
about_para_1: Denham Electrical was founded 18 years ago in Newcastle with a simple mission: honest, fast electrical work at fair prices. Since then, we've built our reputation one satisfied customer at a time, tackling everything from midnight emergency call-outs to complete house rewires. All our engineers are fully qualified, NICEIC registered, and carry their credentials with them.
about_para_2: Word of mouth keeps us busy—most of our work comes from repeat customers and their friends. We pride ourselves on turning up on time, diagnosing faults quickly, and explaining what needs doing before we pick up a tool. No surprises on the bill. That's why homeowners and landlords across Newcastle trust us with their electrics.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Our kitchen electrics went down on a Sunday and we panicked. Rang Denham and a lad was round within 45 minutes. Turned out to be a faulty socket. Cost a fraction of what another firm quoted. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had my house rewired by Denham last spring. The team was tidy, professional, and finished on time. They explained everything as they went and sorted a few extra bits I was worried about without trying to upsell me. Would absolutely use them again.
reviews.author: Emma R.

reviews.text: Called for an EICR certificate for my rental property. Quick appointment, clear report, and they fixed the issues on site. No messing about, no jargon. Very impressed with the whole process.
reviews.author: David P.
